name: Diretório lateral
prompt: High-fidelity 16:10 desktop homepage for a Brazilian Law course. Pale concrete interface, carbon-black rods, black spherical nodes and thin tension-red cords. Compact header; left 38% contains ESTUDOS DE DIREITO, Curso de Direito, a short explanation and a numbered semantic register with exactly four disciplines: Introdução ao Estudo do Direito, Ética, Direito Penal, Direito Constitucional I. Right 62% contains a large code-native SVG-style Atomium network whose four clickable nodes correspond to the register. Fine engineering leader lines explain that the structure reorganizes when disciplines change. Academic discipline directory only, no topics or study cards. Technical condensed grotesk labels, readable sans-serif names, rigorous Swiss grid, accessible focus states. No gavels, justice scales, court columns, books, generic cards, ornamental serif, gradients, glassmorphism, photos or people.
